body:
## Objective

Resolve the single bounded fixture/harness scheduling mismatch that stopped Issue #19, then resume the existing Q04–Q11 qualification **without discarding or rewriting the preserved incomplete evidence**.

Current preserved state:
- PR #20 remains draft/unmerged.
- Branch: `research/issue-19-lean-identity-time-spike`
- Current head: `c70aa329c8ebfc993e0048b1142a7db22fbdcf9b`
- Status: `LEAN_IDENTITY_TIME_GATE_INCOMPLETE`
- Q04_before / Q04_at / Q04_after passed twice deterministically.
- Q04_missing stopped on dispatch mismatch:
  expected Jan6 quote availability/dispatch ceiling vs Jan7 decision/host start.
- Q04_overlap + Q05–Q11 remain unrun.
- Exact-head Ubuntu and Windows Foundation CI on c70aa329... were independently verified successful after the worker lost GitHub auth.

Read before changing anything:
- Issue #19
- PR #20 packet, especially `LEAN_IDENTITY_TIME_GATE_20261019.md`, `decision.json`, `INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.md`, `ORACLE_REVIEW.md`, and checkpoint
- merged Issue #11 fixture matrix
- merged Issue #17 terminal qualification
- trading-project skill/policy

## First task: adjudicate the mismatch, do not guess

Determine from the merged Q04 contract and frozen fixture intent whether the Jan6 quote availability retained in the missing/overlap variants is:
1. an **authored fixture timing error** inconsistent with the intended Jan7 decision scenario, or
2. an intentional requirement the harness must faithfully represent.

Use a fresh independent review of the exact Q04 wording and existing v1/v2 frozen records before changing any fixture.

### If it is an authored fixture error

Do **not** alter or delete v1/v2. Create an explicitly versioned v3 amendment containing only the minimum timing corrections necessary to make the malformed mapping variants internally coherent. Preserve all identity/economic/scientific expectations. Document:
- old values;
- new values;
- why each changed field is necessary;
- why no requirement or scientific outcome changed;
- hashes for every version.

Run fresh independent oracle review on v3 before any native execution.

### If it is intentional

Do not move the oracle to fit the host. Adapt the harness only through public/qualified seams while preserving exact clocks and causality. If that requires a forbidden workaround or causal invention, return `LEAN_BLOCKER_FOUND`.

## Resume scope

Only after the mismatch is resolved and independently approved, resume the existing Issue #19 gate:
- rerun Q04_missing;
- run Q04_overlap;
- then run Q05–Q11 exactly as designed.

Reuse prior accepted Q04_before/at/after evidence only if all code/source/runtime/config bindings required for reuse are proven unchanged. Otherwise rerun them rather than assuming.

Do not run Q12–Q33.

## Stop / decision states

Return exactly one:
- `LEAN_IDENTITY_TIME_GATE_PASS` if all required Q04–Q11 variants pass;
- `LEAN_BLOCKER_FOUND` if a contract requirement needs a forbidden workaround or LEAN cannot satisfy it;
- `LEAN_IDENTITY_TIME_GATE_INCOMPLETE` if another bounded technical fact prevents a defensible decision.

Immediate stop still applies for current-symbol remapping, clock substitution, causal reordering, future-data leakage, adjusted/raw substitution, silent unit/gap repair, reflection/private access/core fork, paid entitlement, credentials, broker/provider auth, scientific-registration change, or any Q12–Q33 scope expansion.

## Git / PR workflow

Continue the **existing** branch `research/issue-19-lean-identity-time-spike` and update **existing draft PR #20**; do not create a duplicate branch/PR.

Start by verifying live GitHub authentication and that branch head is exactly `c70aa329c8ebfc993e0048b1142a7db22fbdcf9b` or reconcile any legitimate newer head before work.

Preserve durable checkpoints and every prior failed/accepted artifact. Never overwrite frozen evidence.

On final head:
- repository 240-test suite;
- packet comparator/adversarial checks;
- terminal regression comparator;
- synthetic demo;
- fresh independent final review;
- exact-head Ubuntu + Windows Foundation CI.

Do not merge. Stop at the final decision and updated draft PR.

## Boundaries

No FMBH/Databento or Amendment 005 change, no candidate advancement, no alpha/performance experiment, no broker plugin qualification, no Paper/Live, no credentials, no paid calls/purchases, no scientific registration change.
title: Resolve Q04 fixture timing mismatch and resume LEAN Q04–Q11
